response_scope: All current survey responses must be exported. Decisions cover completed task responses matched through current_participants.json to shelter_barrier_evidence.csv.
evidence_rule: Assess each reported condition from its current photo, inspection, access-control, camera, maintenance, or work-order evidence. Assistive context and satisfaction history do not change credibility.
blocked_entrance_rule: A required accessible entrance is blocked when its marked route is narrower than 1.00 meter, its door cannot open fully, or a lock or obstruction prevents entry. A shelter with any current blocked required accessible entrance is NOT READY until correction and reinspection are recorded.
other_barrier_rule: Preserve substantiated nonblocking and wayfinding barriers in the plan with their current evidence, action, owner, and completion gate.

case_actions.ACC-491: Remove all pallets immediately, restore at least 1.00 meter of clear approach width, verify full door travel, and complete facilities reinspection before accessible designation.
case_actions.ACC-492: Remove the chain and padlock immediately, verify both panic bars and full door travel, and complete facilities reinspection before accessible designation.
case_actions.ACC-493: Tighten and load-check both outer handrail anchors before shelter opening and record the maintenance result.
case_actions.ACC-495: Install the approved tactile entrance sign before shelter opening and confirm placement during the opening inspection.

retention: Keep the full response export only in the task workspace and do not place it in Yuque.
